prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished background plate for a mature 2D side-view action game called The Hollow Belfry, to be directly loaded behind real gameplay. Landscape 1536x1024 composition. Elegant painterly dark fantasy with ancient elven architecture and abandoned precision machinery; luminous mist, exquisite materials and strong atmospheric depth, sophisticated and melancholy. Absolutely NO people, NO characters, NO creatures, NO text, NO UI, NO letters, NO playable foreground platforms. Architecture is recessed into the distance; leave the central 65 percent relatively open and uncluttered so the small real game hero and foreground ledges remain legible. Architectural framing at far edges, avoid a centered symmetrical doorway. Crisp painted detail at edges, atmospheric midtones at center, never muddy black. A single coherent full-bleed environment, not an atlas or collage. Windbell Gate: a high open cliff-city atrium suspended above a pale blue cloud ocean. Weathered ivory flying buttresses, torn slate-blue ceremonial banners suspended diagonally, huge distant hanging bells and copper chains, immense cool silver daylight sweeping leftward through cloud, airy vertical depth. The player is looking sideways into a vast shaft between buildings, not walking along a perspective road. Quiet blue grey and warm tarnished gold.
